name: Explosive Arrows
description: Gunpowder arrows that burst where they land, hurting what's near and breaking no blocks. An arrow and two gunpowder make one, anywhere they fit. A bow shoots whichever arrows come first in your inventory, the hotbar first, so where you keep them decides; dispensers shoot them too. The blast is a small one of beta's own: a direct hit takes over half a zombie's health, it hurts you too if you fire too close, and TNT it reaches goes off.
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
